config.notes: Curtin course pages www.curtin.edu.au/study/offering/course-{ug|pg|rs|research}-... (stored mostly in the DOMESTIC view, ?segment=dom). Key information panel: Duration ("if you study full-time. 4 years full-time"), Attendance mode, Location, Intake (study-period names: Semester 1/2, Research Term 1/2, Trimester, Extended Term, Block Session). English: course IELTS table "Overall band score N" (same in both views). Fee: only where the page carries the international block "2026 International indicative fees Indicative year 1 fee $N" (few stored pages); domestic CSP fees are never read. term_months: Semester 1 = February, Semester 2 = July (Curtin Kalgoorlie course guide 2026 key dates, publications.curtin.edu.au/curtin-kalgoorlie-course-guide/page/2-3, orientation 10-13 Feb / 14-17 Jul 2026, 9-12 Feb 2027); Research Term 1 = 1 Jan-30 Jun, Research Term 2 = 1 Jul-31 Dec (www.curtin.edu.au/study/applying/application-deadlines/). Trimester, Extended Term and Block Session names are not mapped (months vary by year). atlas.curtin.edu.au/singapore pages are Curtin Singapore (S$ total fees) and choose.curtin.edu.au is a marketing page; the adapter does not read fees from them. 5 Oct 13:02: course pages are read in the INTERNATIONAL view (page_view suffix ?region=int, Firecrawl render, url_pattern www.curtin.edu.au/study/offering/course-); the international view prints Attendance mode, Intake, IELTS and "<year> International indicative fees Indicative year 1 fee"; the fee pattern reads the international indicative year 1 fee in both printed forms ("2027 International indicative fees Indicative year 1 fee $N" and research-degree "Indicative year 1 fee (2027) $N"), 2027 when printed, else 2026; total course fees and the $10,000 Global Future Leaders scholarship credit are never read.
